description: This file defines the main entry point for a process that manages a worker pool, handles signals, loads proxy stubs, and spawns plugins based on command-line options. It includes class definitions for WorkerPoolImplementation, Sink, ConsoleOptions, and ProcessFlow, and contains the main function that initializes and runs the process.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker pool with an associated dispatcher and callback sink, managing thread pool operations and signal handling.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Callback class for handling library flush and object destruction events, signaling the parent worker pool to stop when no objects remain.

classes.name: ConsoleOptions
classes.description: Parses and stores command-line options for configuring the process, including paths, interface IDs, and logging levels.

classes.name: ProcessFlow
classes.description: Main class managing the process lifecycle, including startup, running, and shutdown of the worker pool and plugin interface acquisition.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, parses command-line arguments, initializes process, and manages plugin spawning based on options.
